title: Metsuke & Uketsuke
description: Leios key roster, metsuke telemetry ingest and the uketsuke report inbox on the metsuke host.

panels.title: metsuke-server
panels.description: systemd state of metsuke-server.service. Pages after 5 minutes down.

panels.title: uketsuke
panels.description: systemd state of uketsuke.service. Pages after 5 minutes down.

panels.title: uketsuke roster
panels.description: uketsuke_roster_ok: 1 while the key roster is valid and younger than roster_max_age_secs (3h). At 0 uketsuke refuses every upload with roster_unavailable.

panels.title: Roster age
panels.description: Seconds since metsuke-roster last rewrote roster.json. It regenerates hourly; metsuke_roster_stale pages at 2h and uketsuke refuses uploads at 3h.

panels.title: Roster
panels.description: Pools with a Leios key in the roster, and the epoch the roster was taken in.

panels.title: Pools submitting
panels.description: Distinct pools with at least one metsuke upload accepted in the last hour.

panels.title: uketsuke quota
panels.description: Reserved bytes against max_total_bytes. Reservations are never reclaimed, so this only grows until the quota is raised. Warns at 80%.

panels.title: uketsuke in flight
panels.description: Admitted uploads and receipt lookups in flight, against max_inflight. uketsuke_inflight is absent until the first request is admitted.

panels.title: Service state
panels.description: Whether each long-running unit is active. metsuke-roster is a oneshot; the roster panels below show it.

panels.title: Roster age
panels.description: How old roster.json is, as metsuke's textfile exporter and uketsuke each read it. A sawtooth peaking near 1h is healthy. Dashed: metsuke_roster_stale at 2h, uketsuke refusing at 3h.

panels.title: Pools in roster
panels.description: Pools with a Leios key. metsuke_roster_pools_dropped warns below 80% of the count an hour earlier; pools missing from the roster are refused.

panels.title: Roster generator
panels.description: metsuke-roster and its metrics exporter. A node that is down or behind the tip fails the hourly run.

panels.title: Accepted uploads /min
panels.description: Uploads metsuke-server accepted, by file kind, from its `accepted v1/` log lines.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (rate({instance=~"$instance", systemd_unit="metsuke-server.service"} |= "accepted v1/" | regexp `-(?P<kind>[a-z]+)\.jsonl\.zst, (?P<bytes>\d+) bytes, from agent (?P<agent>\S+)$` [$__auto])) * 60

panels.title: Accepted bytes /min
panels.description: Compressed bytes of accepted uploads, by file kind.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (rate({instance=~"$instance", systemd_unit="metsuke-server.service"} |= "accepted v1/" | regexp `-(?P<kind>[a-z]+)\.jsonl\.zst, (?P<bytes>\d+) bytes, from agent (?P<agent>\S+)$` | unwrap bytes [$__auto])) * 60

panels.title: Pools submitting
panels.description: Distinct pools with an accepted upload in the trailing hour, against the same hour a day earlier. metsuke_submitting_pools_dropped warns below 70% of the day-earlier line.

targets.expr: count(sum by (pool) (count_over_time({instance=~"$instance", systemd_unit="metsuke-server.service"} |= "accepted v1/" | regexp `-(?P<pool>pool1[0-9a-z]+)-` [1h] offset 1d)))

panels.title: Refusals /h
panels.description: Refused uploads from identified pools, by cause, and requests from unidentified clients, mostly scanners. metsuke_roster_missing_leios_key warns when one pool is refused for its key for 2h.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate({instance=~"$instance", systemd_unit="metsuke-server.service"} |~ "^refused pool1" | regexp `^refused (?P<pool>pool1[0-9a-z]+): (?P<code>\d+), .*(?P<reason>allowlist|no such Leios key|sealed at)` | label_format reason=`{{ if eq .reason "allowlist" }}not on allowlist{{ else if eq .reason "no such Leios key" }}Leios key not in roster{{ else if eq .reason "sealed at" }}clock skew{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [$__auto])) * 3600

panels.title: nginx requests by route
panels.description: metsuke-leios vhost traffic from the VTS route filter. metsuke_submit_server_errors warns when over 5% of submit is 5xx.

panels.title: nginx mean response time by route
panels.description: Mean time nginx spent per request on each metsuke route, upstream and client transfer included.

panels.title: Pools by agent version (24h)
panels.description: Distinct pools with an accepted upload from each metsuke-agent version over the last day. A pool that upgraded during the day counts under both.

targets.expr: count by (agent) (sum by (agent, pool) (count_over_time({instance=~"$instance", systemd_unit="metsuke-server.service"} |= "accepted v1/" | regexp `-(?P<pool>pool1[0-9a-z]+)-` | regexp `-(?P<kind>[a-z]+)\.jsonl\.zst, (?P<bytes>\d+) bytes, from agent (?P<agent>\S+)$` [24h])))

panels.title: Uploads by pool (24h)
panels.description: Accepted uploads and bytes per pool over the last day. Sort by a column to find the quiet or the loud.

targets.expr: sum by (pool) (sum_over_time({instance=~"$instance", systemd_unit="metsuke-server.service"} |= "accepted v1/" | regexp `-(?P<pool>pool1[0-9a-z]+)-` | regexp `-(?P<kind>[a-z]+)\.jsonl\.zst, (?P<bytes>\d+) bytes, from agent (?P<agent>\S+)$` | unwrap bytes [24h]))

panels.title: Requests per bar
panels.description: Finished upload and receipt requests by outcome. recovered: a retried upload whose object was already stored.

panels.title: Rejections by code per bar
panels.description: Rejected requests by code. fault: codes are server faults and page as uketsuke_server_fault_rejections; the rest are the client's.

panels.title: Request duration
panels.description: p95 and p50 per route over finished requests, client upload time included.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Admitted requests against max_inflight. At the limit uketsuke answers busy; nginx separately caps connections per address.

panels.title: Quota
panels.description: Reserved bytes against max_total_bytes. uketsuke_quota_nearly_spent warns at 80%.

panels.title: nginx requests by route
panels.description: uketsuke-leios vhost traffic from the VTS route filter. A 429 from limit_req or limit_conn counts as 4xx.

panels.title: S3 requests per bar
panels.description: uketsuke's S3 calls by operation and HTTP status, error or timeout. uketsuke_s3_errors warns on 5xx, error and timeout. 404 on head or get is the expected answer for a new submission.

panels.title: S3 latency
panels.description: p95 and p50 S3 request duration per operation; s3_timeout_ms is 30s.

panels.title: metsuke refusals
panels.description: Refusals metsuke-server logged, except 404 no-route answers to scanners; Refusals /h still counts those.

panels.title: uketsuke requests
panels.description: One report per finished upload or receipt request. pool and size are the manifest's claims, authenticated only when accepted or recovered.

targets.expr: {instance=~"$instance", systemd_unit="uketsuke.service"} |= `"event":"request"` | json | line_format `{{.message_route}} {{.message_outcome}}{{with .message_code}} {{.}}{{end}} status={{.message_status}} pool={{.message_pool_id}} size={{.message_file_size}} {{.message_duration_ms}}ms`

panels.title: uketsuke, everything else
panels.description: uketsuke lines other than request reports: startup, S3 and roster errors.
